notes: Global shared-focus registration preserves the historical completion lookup ID without exposing a playable node or repeating rewards.
This source contract is not proof of general save compatibility; current compatibility runtime remains unproven.

panel.coordinate_system: continuous-focus UI panel; separate from focus grid

inlay_windows.coordinate_system: focus inlay UI pixels; independent of focus grid and inherited route offsets

positions_contract.base: Resolved focus grid position with no active route offsets
positions_contract.show: SHOW with democratic entry completed; current offsets inactive
positions_contract.committed_hide: HIDE with KOR_democracy_advance_forward completed and all other route-entry completion conditions false

notes: Each defined node retains a position even when allow_branch would hide it; these are not visible-tree bounds or engine scroll limits.
Each current offset trigger is evaluated from the recorded SHOW/HIDE game-rule option and one route-entry completion; no engine UI or gameplay evaluation is inferred.
Civic chains contain the democratic offset owner once, with no direct civic offsets; the fixed inlay is not in those chains.

All five SHOW cases have no active offsets. Initial HIDE has none. Each completed-route HIDE case uses the existing offset conditions, including the mutually exclusive common republican entry conditions.

inventory.method: Ordered in-memory read of the exact pre-civic worktree source and final deterministic builder output; donor coordinate documents are intent references, not numeric inputs.
does_not_establish: actual RT56 UI layout or click targets
